mapper.select: select sr.id, sr.user_id, em.emp_name, sr.user_type, em.phone_no phone, em.org_name_path org_name, sr.valid_period, em.emp_no, em.emp_login user_name, em.position_name, em.email from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join safety_employee_message em on sr.emp_no = em.emp_no inner join safety_sys_user su on sr.user_id=su.id where sr.del_flag = 0 and su.delete_falg=0 and (em.emp_no like CONCAT('%',#{userInfo},'%') or em.emp_name like CONCAT('%',#{userInfo},'%')) limit 100

select sr.id, sr.user_id, em.emp_name, sr.user_type, em.phone_no phone, em.org_name_path org_name, sr.valid_period, em.emp_no, em.emp_login user_name, em.position_name, em.email from ytsafety_sys_responsible sr inner join safety_employee_message em on sr.emp_no = em.emp_no where sr.del_flag=0 and sr.status=0 and sr.user_id in(select distinct user_id from safety_sys_user_role where role_code=#{roleCode} and del_flag=0) and sr.user_id in(select distinct user_id from ytsafety_sys_user_depart where depart_code=#{orgCode})
